title: Vox Memory Model: Audit & Value-Semantics Optimization Plan
summary: Audit of Vox's value-semantics memory management and phased plan to optimize clone costs via copy-on-write and structural sharing.
notes: Hybrid audit + implementation-plan document. Establishes facts about current memory model (no GC, value semantics), documents Phase 0-2 execution results with benchmarks, and outlines future optimization phases. Structure mixes audit findings with implementation status tracking. Classified as DOC because primary purpose is informational/planning guidance rather than prescriptive contract.
